lines.trans: I have been doing pretty well lately; do not worry about me.
It is alright; Yuanye is my former label, and I did not want to hurt them too badly.
After spending a few days without a talent agency, I have actually grown quite fond of it.
As for the agency you mentioned, I am not going to sign with them.
You are already the top female artist at your agency.
Although that company has plenty of resources and a big enough platform.
Wanting to support the two of us sisters at the same time shows too big an appetite.

words.gram: Meaning: two sisters (or close female friends).

lines.trans: I have not formally signed a contract yet, though it will be soon.
I plan to join Donghai.
Come on, let us toast with tea instead of wine; thank you for your good wishes!

words.gloss: toast with tea instead of wine
words.gram: Meaning: toast with tea instead of wine.
